recency.note: uncalibrated cut: ids at or above it count as new; tune against dated own assets

opportunity.note: uncalibrated: weights and the attention range are starting guesses; calibrate against own sales

lead.note: generate/submit window = buyer lead 8 wk (community anecdote, 2026-10) + review lag 3 wk (one account measured up to ~15 days) + 1 wk margin; community hypothesis, not an Adobe rule

calibration.note: user-chosen floor for showing a downloads-per-asset figure, not a statistical test

own_keywords.note: keywords shared by your sold assets; association only, never copy keywords onto new images

upload_stage.note: Staging puts verified files into the portal's New list; it never submits. The user turns it on (enabled) for a run and off after. Protected folders can never be staged.

upload_metadata.note: Applies the plan's CSV (title, keywords, category) to the files already in the portal's New list, then sets generative AI, people/property and include-in-submission for all of them and saves. It never clicks Submit. The user turns it on for a run and off after. people_property_fictional ticks 'People and Property are fictional' (AI-generated people). people_property is the user's answer to 'Add recognizable people or property?' (no | yes | later).
